UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile in the application.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

customId.description: A custom, human-readable, and sequential ID for the user (e.g., KWUSR0001, KWENR0001).

state.description: The state where the user resides.

district.description: The district where the user resides.

status.description: The status of the user's account.

role.description: The role of the user in the application.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user account was created.

Market.title: Market
Market.description: Represents a game market with its timings and status.

name.description: The name of the market (e.g., Kalyan Day).

openTime.description: The opening time of the market.

closeTime.description: The closing time of the market.

status.description: The current status of the market.

BetType.title: Bet Type
BetType.description: Defines a type of bet that can be placed in a market.

name.description: The name of the bet type (e.g., Jodi, Single Panna).

description.description: A brief explanation of the bet type.

status.description: Whether this bet type is currently available for users.

KalyanResult.title: Kalyan Result
KalyanResult.description: Represents a declared result for a specific market and date.

marketName.description: The name of the market the result is for (e.g., Kalyan Day).

date.description: The date for which the result is declared.

jodi.description: The 2-digit jodi, derived from the pannas.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Path-based ownership, where `userId` matches `request.auth.uid`.
Stores game market information. Publicly readable, but only writable by admins.
Stores the different types of bets available. Publicly readable, admin writable.
Stores declared game results. Publicly readable, admin writable.
